user.title: Configure Free Home Assistant Cloud backup
user.description:
**1. Create a place for your backups**

Already have a private backup repository you want to use? Skip to step 2.

- Open [Create a new repository on GitHub]({new_repository_url}).
- In **Repository name**, type any name you like. For example, `my-home-backups`.
- Under **Visibility**, choose **Private** so your backups stay private.
- Leave the other settings as they are and click **Create repository**.

**2. Give Home Assistant a key to your backup repository**

- Open [Create a GitHub token for Home Assistant]({new_token_url}). The link fills in the token name and permission.
- Under **Expiration**, choose **No expiration** so your backups keep running without having to replace the token on a schedule.
- Under **Resource owner**, choose the account that owns your backup repository. That's usually your GitHub username.
- Under **Repository access**, choose **Only select repositories**, then pick only your new backup repository.
- Under **Permissions**, make sure **Contents** says **Read and write**. This lets Home Assistant save backups and remove old ones.
- Click **Generate token** and copy the long code GitHub shows you. Treat it like a password.

**3. Connect Home Assistant to GitHub**

- Open your backup repository on GitHub. Copy the link from your browser's address bar and paste it into **GitHub repository link** below. If the right link is already filled in, leave it as it is.
- Paste the code from step 2 into **Fine-grained GitHub token**, then click **Submit**.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your GitHub repository
reauth_confirm.description: Create a [fine-grained token]({new_token_url}) for **{repository}** with **Contents: Read and write**, then paste it below.

error.invalid_repository: Open your backup repository on GitHub and paste the link from its main page.
error.access_denied: Check the repository name, token expiration, and Contents read and write permissions.
error.not_private: On GitHub, set the backup repository’s visibility to Private, then try again.
error.rate_limited: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.
error.invalid_token: Enter a valid fine-grained GitHub token. Check whether it has expired or been revoked.
error.wrong_repository: GitHub returned a different repository. Check the configured repository.
error.connection_changed: The GitHub connection changed while you were saving. Open Reconfigure and try again.

create_entry.turn_on_backups:
**4. Turn on GitHub backups**

- Turn on the switch next to **Free Home Assistant Cloud backup**.
- Click its gear and make sure **Encryption** is on. Save your **Backup emergency kit** somewhere safe.
- Under **Retention**, choose how many automatic backups to keep.
- Run a manual backup to this location to confirm GitHub lets Home Assistant upload.

**[Open Backup Locations]({locations_path})**
